subject.title: Add Claw dry-run apply lifecycle plan

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw.clawApplyPlan.v1` and the dry-run `claws apply` CLI shape as the next core Claws lifecycle contract while the base stack remains open?
rationale: The implementation is read-only and no concrete code defect was found, but automation cannot choose durable install-action, consent, provenance, rollback, and future mutation semantics for maintainers.

options.title: Gate On Claws Contract Approval
options.body: Keep this PR open until a maintainer explicitly approves the base Claws stack plus this apply-plan vocabulary.

options.title: Accept The Preview Contract
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally merge this as the compatibility baseline for future Claw install and provenance work.

options.title: Revise Before Merge
options.body: Update the action, provenance, rollback, or consent vocabulary before any plan output becomes depended on.

recommendation.title: Gate On Claws Contract Approval
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open until a maintainer explicitly approves the base Claws stack plus this apply-plan vocabulary.

likelyOwner.reason: The blocker is product-contract approval for a new core lifecycle surface, which best matches the listed project lead role.
